newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Pannonplast opens steady after results.
newsitem.headline: Pannonplast opens steady after results.

text.p: Hungarian plastics group Pannonplast Rt's shares opened unchanged on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Monday following the release of its January-September results.
At 1034 GMT Pannonplast shares were at 5,100 forints, unchanged from their closing price on Friday.
Pannonplast said that its year-on-year sales revenues rose by 10 percent, less than half the rate of inflation, in the January-September period because of low plastic material prices.
Pannonplast reported consolidated IAS sales revenues of 6.848 billion forints in the first nine months of the year compared to sales of 6.218 billion forints in the same last year period.
"Plastics raw material prices have had a large role in sales growth of this measure," Pannonplast said in its result report.
"While the average purchase price was lower than than in the same period last year the price of finished products did not change or -- similarly to competitors -- decreased," it said.
"Consequently, the company did not raise its prices in most product groups or in certain cases it provided discount."
Pannonplast's operating profit rose by 29 percent to 873 million forints from 678 million, while its income before taxes grew by 65.2 percent to 1.317 billion from 797 million.
The group's net income surged by more than 77 percent to 1.064 billion forints in January-September from 599 million in the same nine months in 1995, it said.

In the third quarter sales of plastic pipe products equalled the corresponding period in 1995, but the company could not entirely catch up with the lag it had in the first quarter of 1996 due to the harsh winter, it said.
However, there was strong growth both in volume and product range at companies producing packaging materials, it added.
